title: The Snail Who Lights the Lamps | A Tiny Town Bedtime Story
altTitles: Lumen's Evening Round (Cozy Narrated Miniature Story)
Every Lamp in the Tiny Town, Lit by One Snail
description:
Lumen the snail lamplighter makes his evening round of Thimble Town, from his matchbox home to the top of the thimble tower. A softly narrated miniature bedtime story.

0:00 Sunset
0:31 The matchbox
1:11 The first lamp
1:51 Noodle Row
2:41 The spool bridge
3:26 The teapot
4:41 The harbour
5:31 The tower
6:31 Every lamp

Stories and worlds created with AI tools.
